summary: Apply probability, confidence intervals and hypothesis tests to business data. Build Excel analysis and decision briefs. Explore the course.
lede: Probability and hypothesis testing help business professionals distinguish meaningful changes from ordinary variation in performance data. For analysts, finance and operations teams, and managers, the training develops skills in selecting suitable tests, interpreting confidence intervals and p-values, assessing practical significance and assumptions, and communicating findings through Excel-supported decision briefs.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who use business data to compare outcomes, evaluate variation, or advise colleagues on whether a measured change merits action. It is designed for people who need to explain statistical evidence in practical business terms.
prerequisites: Bring working familiarity with percentages, averages, basic charts, and spreadsheet formulas. No programming or coding is required. You will use Excel for calculations and interpretation exercises.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
